# scripts/nobuild-baseline.txt
#
# Units that do NOT survive `tyc build`. Generated by:
#     scripts/vm-differential.sh --update
#
# Unlike the divergence baseline, most lines here are INTENDED:
# the stress corpus exists partly to pin diagnostics, so a probe
# written to be rejected belongs in this list. The gate fails in
# both directions anyway — a unit that stops building is a
# regression, and one that starts building means a diagnostic
# stopped firing. Either way the list, and the reason, must be
# updated deliberately.
#
# Generated 2026-09-02 against tyc 1.0.0-alpha.9
# Scope: all
#
